record.question: Free market is
options: a condition in the international market where nations do not impose customs duty or other taxes on import of goods
market where the price of a commodity is determined by free play of the forces of supply and demand
ports that are exempted from payment of customs duty on articles of commerce, primarily to encourage tourism
record.explanation: Answer B: market where the price of a commodity is determined by free play of the forces of supply and demand. In the standard definition, a free market allocates goods through supply and demand, with prices determined by their interaction; the stem’s import-tariff and free-port descriptions are narrower alternatives. Reference: https://www.britannica.com/money/free-market. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
